title: Dispatch: ghzh featureImprovement dispositions (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-ghzh (read `bd show eshyra-ghzh` for defect, scope and acceptance criteria). Supervisor decisions below are made; do not re-litigate them, but STOP and report in notes if the code contradicts a premise.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-ghzh.1 on branch eshyra-ghzh.1 (cut from origin/main d9be4acb). Run `npm ci` there first.

CODE SURVEY
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpEngine.ts: featureImprovementChoices() (~line 940) emits status 'unsupported' for every ResolvedFeatureImprovement {targetRefs,label} of the target progression row; called from detectLevelUpRequiredChoices (~line 877). resolveLevelUpChoices() pushes every unsupported choice into blockers. LevelUpChangeSet (~line 140) is persisted opaquely as the ledger event appliedChanges. applyChangeSetToSheet / applyFeatureChoicesToSheet (~line 1531) persists featureChoice picks on CharacterSheet.featureChoices (CharacterFeatureChoice {featureRef, choiceId, optionIds, level} in finalizeCharacter.ts).
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpFeatureChoices.ts: structured list-choice descriptors/validation/apply (ug4i.3); REPEATED_GRANT_PICKS is the precedent for "extra picks on an already-held feature". Its header comment says featureImprovement rows stay unsupported - update it.
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpChoiceCoverage.ts: descriptorId / choiceInstanceKey helpers and the coverage invariant (every detector reports handledInstances). Keep the invariant green.
- packages/core/src/character/rulesPackResolver.ts ResolvedFeatureImprovement.
- Pack rows (records.json, query: advancement[] kind 'featureImprovement' on class records): cleric 20 Divine Intervention improvement [feature:cleric:divine-intervention]; druid 4 and 8 Wild Shape improvement [feature:druid:wild-shape]; monk 9 Unarmored Movement improvement [feature:monk:unarmored-movement]; paladin 18 Aura improvements [aura-of-protection, aura-of-courage]; ranger 6 Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements [favored-enemy, natural-explorer]; ranger 10 Natural Explorer improvement; ranger 14 Favored Enemy improvement. Pinned by EXPECTED_IMPROVEMENT_ROWS in packages/core/test/rulesPackCharacterResolver.test.ts (do not change that pin).
- feature:ranger:favored-enemy choices[] = {id 'favored-enemy', category favoredEnemy, level 1, choose 1, from [13 creature types]}; feature:ranger:natural-explorer choices[] = {id 'favored-terrain', category naturalExplorer, level 1, choose 1, from [7 terrains]}. SRD text in the records: "You choose one additional favored enemy, as well as an associated language, at 6th and 14th level." / "You choose additional favored terrain types at 6th and 10th level."
- CLI: packages/cli guided level-up flow and packages/core/src/character/guidedLevelUpFlow.ts present supported descriptors; confirm the new descriptors flow through them unchanged (they are ordinary featureChoice list choices).

DECISIONS
1. Disposition per improvement, keyed by target feature (not by a hand list of class/level):
   a. PLAYER DECISION: a target feature whose pack record has a structured list choice of category favoredEnemy or naturalExplorer (the ranger rows). For each such target emit one SUPPORTED descriptor: choose 1 from the same `from` list minus options the sheet already holds in featureChoices for that (featureRef, choiceId). Persist as an additional CharacterFeatureChoice entry {featureRef, choiceId, optionIds:[pick], level: toLevel} via the existing applied-featureChoice path. It must NOT overwrite or merge away the level-1 entry; check what applyFeatureChoicesToSheet does with an existing (featureRef, choiceId) and make the additional pick a separate level-tagged entry (or a correct merge that preserves both picks and levels; pick whichever the existing code/validator supports, and say which). A duplicate of a held option is rejected with a clear reason. Reuse levelUpFeatureChoices.ts machinery (validation, option display, descriptorId) rather than a parallel path.
   b. LEGACY sheets with no recorded level-1 pick (creation does not record it yet - eshyra-nnj6): the additional pick proceeds with an empty exclusion set; do not require or backfill the level-1 pick. Document this.
   c. MODEL-ADJUDICATED: Cleric 20 Divine Intervention, Druid 4/8 Wild Shape, Monk 9 Unarmored Movement, Paladin 18 auras. Verify by grep that no deterministic engine consumer reads these features' limits (wild shape CR/swim/fly, aura range, divine intervention roll, monk vertical/liquid movement); if one exists, STOP and report. These do not block; the improved effect remains DM-adjudicated and discoverable via lookup_rules.
   d. "Automatic" (engine-applied state change with no decision): none expected. If you find a row that truly is one, justify it in notes; do not invent state.
   e. Anything else (an improvement row whose target matches none of the above, e.g. a future pack change): stays an unsupported fail-closed descriptor whose unsupportedReason names the row label and target refs.
2. Change set: add optional `featureImprovements?: readonly LevelUpFeatureImprovement[]` to LevelUpChangeSet, each {label, targetRefs, disposition: 'player-decision' | 'model-adjudicated'} (add a short note field only if useful). Present whenever the target row has improvement rows that resolved. It reaches the ledger through appliedChanges. Player-decision picks also appear in choicesApplied like other featureChoice picks.
3. Humanoid-races alternative and the associated language for Favored Enemy are NOT structured in the pack. Do not invent them in the engine. Record the limitation in the doc and file a follow-up bead (bd create, label srd, discovered-from eshyra-ghzh) to route the pack gap through docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not edit the pack in this bead.
4. Docs: in docs/design/character-progression.md add the pack-derived inventory table (row, target refs, disposition, SRD citation = the feature record ref + quoted sentence) and the legacy-sheet rule. Update the levelUpFeatureChoices.ts header comment.

EVIDENCE (tests against the real generated pack; extend existing level-up test files rather than creating sprawling new ones)
- Ranger 5->6: two supported descriptors (favored enemy + favored terrain); apply persists both new entries at level 6 alongside held level-1 entries; picking an already-held option fails with a reason; ledger appliedChanges carries featureImprovements with disposition player-decision.
- Ranger 9->10 (terrain only) and a legacy ranger sheet with no level-1 featureChoices leveling 5->6.
- Druid 3->4 and Cleric 19->20 apply successfully with model-adjudicated dispositions in the change set; Monk 8->9 or Paladin 17->18 likewise (one is enough).
- An unrecognized improvement (synthetic resolver row or stubbed resolver, whichever the test infra supports cheaply) stays blocked with a reason naming it.
Do not add count/inventory tests that merely restate the table.

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-ghzh.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-ghzh.1 --append-notes` (what changed, decisions taken on 1a merge semantics, test names, verify result, follow-up bead ids); `bd close eshyra-ghzh.1`.
notes: Done. featureImprovement rows dispositioned by target feature via classifyFeatureImprovements (levelUpFeatureChoices.ts): favoredEnemy/naturalExplorer list-choice targets -> supported 'choose 1' descriptor (held options excluded), persisted as a SEPARATE level-tagged featureChoices entry through the existing push path in applyFeatureChoicesToSheet (level-1 entry untouched); Cleric/Druid/Monk/Paladin targets -> model-adjudicated (grep confirmed no engine consumers); other targets -> unsupported naming label+targetRefs. Change set gains featureImprovements[{label,targetRefs,disposition}]. Legacy sheets: empty exclusion set. No automatic rows exist. Docs table+rules added to docs/design/character-progression.md. Tests in levelUpFeatureChoices.test.ts (describe 'feature improvements (eshyra-ghzh.1)': ranger 5->6, dup rejection, ranger 10, legacy, druid 3->4, unrecognized stub) and levelUpEngine.test.ts (Cleric 19->20). verify:worktree passed (6086 tests). Follow-up: eshyra-mdke (pack gap humanoid races/language).
